reviewer: Codex assistant, not independent human gold

geometry_controls.physical_false_positive: 1 if any caption asserts unsupported physical object addition, removal, replacement, state/color/pose change, count change or individual physical relocation. Global image shift/rotation/scale, apparent size change or explicit crop/visibility effects do not count. Ambiguous claims are recorded separately rather than forced false.
geometry_controls.strict_no_change: 1 if no unsupported physical change is asserted; an answer that merely says images look the same can be physically correct even if it misses framing change.
geometry_controls.geometry_acknowledged: Separately record whether camera/framing/global transformation is explicitly recognized for nonidentity controls.
geometry_controls.identity: Identical decoded pixels, same PNG content. Any claimed visible/physical difference is incorrect; report identity separately to avoid confusing identity recognition with transform robustness.

natural_pairs.supported_fact_hits: Count only explicit, semantically correct mentions of the locked facts below. Partial mention is 0 unless it captures the main changed attribute/event. Do not award mere naming of an unchanged object.
natural_pairs.unsupported_claims: List clear invented changes separately. A new item can mean newly visible; do not penalize unclear addition versus occlusion unless caption explicitly contradicts persistent content.

masking: Read masked_predictions.json only, record per-candidate scores and evidence in masked_assessments.json, save it, then open mask_key.json. Candidate mapping hidden, but stylistic differences may reveal prompting, so masking is procedural rather than independent blinded human evaluation.
uncertainty: Scene-level paired bootstrap with six scenes per partition; report descriptive paired counts and CIs, avoid significance claims from tiny correlated set. No new prompt candidates after these outcomes.
